notes: Pint had never been configured, so it ran the bare `laravel` preset and reported 59 of the repo's files as violations.

Almost all of that was one rule: `binary_operator_spaces` wanted to strip the aligned `=>` columns this codebase uses everywhere (casts(), rules(), messages(), resource payloads). That alignment is deliberate and readable, and letting a formatter delete it across 44 files would be a large diff that improves nothing.

Aligning INSTEAD of disabling was tried and rejected: `align_single_space_minimal` still disagreed with 31 files, because php-cs-fixer's grouping does not reproduce how these files are aligned by hand. Turning the rule off is the only setting that leaves existing operator spacing untouched, in either direction.

Everything else in the preset is kept. The remaining failures are not house style — trailing newlines, CRLF line endings, brace placement, import order — and should be fixed rather than configured away.
